Consistency with the provider's own implementation only; the provider publishes no separate statement, and no product detection, support status or scanner behaviour is claimed.

ev-5c1f3a9d72.rationale: Provider-owned crates.io source: AccessToken::from_str returns InvalidLength unless the remainder after cio_tp_ is 32 characters; the fixtures have an empty remainder (prefix at end of line) and a 12-character remainder. Consistency with the provider's own implementation only; the provider publishes no separate statement, and no product detection, support status or scanner behaviour is claimed.

sources.supports: Doc comment: the token consists of a prefix, a random alphanumeric string (31 characters) and a single-character checksum.
PREFIX = "cio_tp_" and RAW_LENGTH = 31.
AccessToken::from_str strips the exact prefix cio_tp_ (MissingPrefix), requires the remainder to be RAW_LENGTH + 1 = 32 characters (InvalidLength) and ASCII alphanumeric only (InvalidCharacter).
Unit test asserts the stated error for the example.

ev-717cdd6332.rationale: Provider-owned crates.io source: the prefix is the case-sensitive string cio and HashedToken::parse rejects any string that does not start with it; the fixture uses the upper-case prefix CIO, which does not start with cio. Consistency with the provider's own implementation only; the provider publishes no separate statement, and no product detection, support status or scanner behaviour is claimed.
